title: Kenji's three faces from h4
question: Which neutral, which grin and which sheepish face should Kenji use in the game?

media.caption: All 19 attempts in order, faces only, h4 first. Only the face was repainted (brows to chin, inside the jaw line); his hair, shirt, hands and everything else are h4's own pixels. Tries 2 and 3 used a lighter repaint (0.65) that kept h4's open mouth; tries 4 and 5 redrew his nose, so from try 6 on h4's nose is kept. Sheepish had level brows at first: s2 adds "nervous" and a sweat drop, s3 then weights the worried brows. Prompts and settings for each: prompts.json in the same folder.

The same 19, cut out and framed on the game canvas (597 x 768, his face the same size as Mio's and Mr. Mori's), on the dark game colour. The pen pot and books behind him are taken out. His left arm (image right) ends at the picture edge, where the render ends.

Image check sheet. It flags red rim at about 11% on every attempt, h4 included. Every flagged pixel is on his bare skin (arms, cheek, ear): the warm skin shading, not a red light. The outline is h4's in all of them.
What the game shows today (the provisional 711 portrait), for comparison.
